Name: angel
Description: Beautiful, otherworldly beings characterised by their signature halo and feathered wings. Strongly attuned to the struggle between good and evil, they sense the divinity within anything they hold.

Name: angel warrior
Description: A soldier of the host: armed, armoured, and entirely without doubt.

Name: cherubim
Description: Not the plump children of paintings: four faces, a great many wings, and a mandate to guard.

Name: eshim
Description: The least of the host, made of fire and formed for one errand at a time.

Name: galgalim
Description: The wheels within wheels, rimmed with eyes, turning without ever facing away.

Name: seraphim
Description: The burning ones. They stand nearest the throne, and everything near them catches.

Name: blind cave bat
Description: A giant bat with clouded, sightless eyes, navigating wholly by the shriek of its own echo.

Name: storm ape
Description: An ape with a crackling, wire-taut hide, native to the thunderheads above the high peaks.

Name: duck
Description: A plump waterfowl, unbothered by dungeons so long as there is a puddle nearby.

Name: storm raven
Description: A raven with feathers like beaten iron, riding the thunderheads and stooping with a crack of static.

Name: acid blob
Description: This strange living bubble of corrosive fluids doesn't appear to have any offensive capabilities.

Name: Byakko
Description: The white tiger of the west, in whose season metal is forged and old things are cut away.

Name: ember panther
Description: A panther whose black coat smoulders at the edges, leaving smoking pawprints on stone.

Name: frost lynx
Description: A lynx with a rime-white winter coat, breath fogging even in a warm room.

Name: pheral khit
Description: The young of the pheral: all claws, and no patience whatever.

Name: pheral pharaoh
Description: Wrapped, crowned, and extremely displeased to have been woken.

Name: pheral sentinel
Description: Stands at the door of the tomb with a blade in either hand, and has been standing there a very long time.

Name: pheral vizier
Description: He does not fight. He arranges matters so that the fighting has already been decided.

Name: changeling
Description: Shape-shifting deviants, who thrive on their deceptive talents.

Name: demon
Description: Perverse creatures of many aberrations but always with crimson skin and horns. Their mere presence compels others to act out their darkest, most violent desires.

Name: female demon
Description: She was beautiful once, in the way a knife is beautiful, and the resemblance has not altogether faded.

Name: tempter
Description: He offers you exactly what you wanted, and the price is not mentioned until afterwards.

Name: astral dog
Description: A hound of the Astral plane, half-seen even when it stands still; it does not breathe or bleed.

Name: astral puppy
Description: A young astral dog, still learning to keep all four paws on the material plane at once.

Name: blink dog
Description: A fey hound that flickers between here and elsewhere; it fights alongside anyone it trusts.

Name: blink puppy
Description: A blink dog pup, already able to flicker away from danger before it lands a bite.

Name: plague jackal
Description: A jackal wasted by sickness, its ribs showing through a mangy hide; its bite festers.

Name: storm coyote
Description: A coyote with a static-charged coat, drawn down from the high plains after a lightning storm.

Name: dracon
Description: Imposing and heavily built, they resemble humanoid dragons with a snout, scaly hide and functional wings.

Name: adult astral dragon
Description: It drifts in and out of the here and now, and its breath arrives from somewhere that is not quite the room.

Name: adult fae dragon
Description: It keeps the courtesies of the fey courts exactly as far as they amuse it.

Name: adult grey dragon
Description: Nothing cast at a grey dragon has ever much troubled it, and it knows this better than you do.

Name: adult mystical dragon
Description: Steeped in high magic, and quite capable of being something else by the time you swing.

Name: ancient astral dragon
Description: It has spent so long between the planes that it is only visiting this one. Distance means nothing to it.

Name: ancient fae dragon
Description: It has been playing the same joke for eight hundred years and has not yet reached the end of it.

Name: ancient grey dragon
Description: Old enough that magic simply stops happening near it. Whatever it was once, it is now a hole in the weave.

Name: ancient mystical dragon
Description: Centuries of study, and a library underneath it that no scholar will ever be allowed to see.

Name: baby astral dragon
Description: A hatchling that keeps half-vanishing while you look at it, and has not yet worked out how to stop.

Name: baby fae dragon
Description: A hatchling out of the fey courts: bright-eyed, quick, and already lying to you.

Name: baby grey dragon
Description: A grey hatchling, already contemptuous of magic and of you.

Name: baby mystical dragon
Description: A hatchling that has already learned one word it should not know.

Name: young astral dragon
Description: Scales like the silver void between the planes. It steps out of the world when it is losing.

Name: young fae dragon
Description: More prankster than predator, which is not the same as harmless.

Name: young grey dragon
Description: Its scales drink spells the way sand drinks water. Wizards have learned to leave grey dragons alone.

Name: young mystical dragon
Description: It hoards grimoires the way other dragons hoard gold, and it has read them.

Name: dwarf
Description: Stout, short and hardy folk. They are known for their stubbornness, metalworking and love of alcohol.

Name: frost dwarf
Description: A dwarf of a mountain clan so far north the forge-fires burn blue; one of its twin mattocks bites like the wind off the peak.

Name: echo
Description: Astral beings who are a vessel for the indomitable spirit of a vanquished adventurer. Having no motivations of their own, they are glad to permit the possession; for the deceased adventurer, it is a second chance at revenge or redemption. Born from astral matter, they are slightly built, translucent and can move freely through physical obstacles.

Name: acid elemental
Description: A walking pool of acid, held in the shape of a body by something with an appetite.

Name: acid sphere
Description: A hovering bead of acid, small enough to ignore and stupid enough to close the distance anyway.

Name: air sphere
Description: A knot of turning air about the size of a head. It has no face, and it follows you regardless.

Name: ash elemental
Description: Everything that is left when a fire has finished, and still hot enough for it to matter.

Name: brine elemental
Description: A standing wave of brackish swamp water, thick with algae and old poison; nothing in it is fresh, and nothing about touching it is safe.

Name: energy elemental
Description: Raw current given legs. The air around it tastes of a storm that has not arrived yet.

Name: explosive elemental
Description: It is holding itself together, and it is not going to manage that for very much longer.

Name: explosive sphere
Description: A sphere with a short temper and a shorter future.

Name: sonic elemental
Description: A standing wave, loud enough to be solid. You feel it in your teeth before you see it.

Name: sonic sphere
Description: A hovering note that will not stop rising.

Name: drow mage
Description: Drow magic is taught underground, quietly, and it is used the same way.

Name: drow monk
Description: Bare hands, bare feet, and a discipline that took thirty years in the dark to learn.

Name: drow priestess
Description: She speaks for the spider goddess, and the enclave does whatever she says the goddess wants.

Name: drow thief
Description: Sees perfectly in the dark, moves perfectly in it, and is already behind you.

Name: elf
Description: Spiritual beings fond of nature and magic. They are physically similar to humans, but often smaller and nimbler.

Name: noble elf
Description: Old blood, old grudges, and a sword that has been in the family longer than the family has held the land.

Name: sun elf
Description: An elf of the sunlit dunes, skin bronzed and eyes narrowed; its arrows are fletched with fire-hardened reed and fly burning.

Name: fairy
Description: Tiny winged spirits, inherently magical and extraordinarily beautiful. When threatened, they can escape through distortions in spatial reality.

Name: Nymph Princess
Description: She rules a court of nymphs and has never yet had to raise a hand to keep it.

Name: acid spore
Description: A bulbous fungus that bursts into a hissing cloud of acid when disturbed.

Name: frost wraith
Description: A shade gone pale and crystalline, trailing frost wherever it drifts; the cold pours off it before it ever draws near.

Name: ash giant
Description: A giant caked grey with volcanic ash, walking down from a smoking peak with a club still smoking at the tip.

Name: giant
Description: An ancient race of towering recluses. Their terrifying size gives them immense strength, supplemented by a voracious diet of meats and minerals.

Name: Gianta Klaus
Description: A giant in red who arrives once a year with a sack, and whose generosity is best not put to the test.

Name: ice giant
Description: A giant of the high glaciers, sheathed in rime; its breath alone can flash-freeze a puddle solid.

Name: cave gnome
Description: A gnome who never left the deep tunnels, pale and stooped, at ease chewing through rock with a pickaxe.

Name: gnome
Description: Subterranean peoples of diminutive stature, fond of tinkering and magic. Evolved for subsistence living, their metabolism is suited for long adventures where food is scarce.

Name: bronze golem
Description: A golem cast from bronze rather than raw iron; where its cousin only staggers under a lightning strike, this one drinks the current and spits it back.

Name: silver golem
Description: Cast in silver at ruinous expense, and worth it: nothing rots it, nothing charms it, and it never tires.

Name: tin golem
Description: Beaten out of scrap tin by an apprentice who wanted to prove a point. It rattles as it walks.

Name: halfling
Description: Small folk who prefer simple lives. They are notably gregarious and their build lends them well to less-than-noble endeavours.

Name: halfling female caveman
Description: Small, wary, and quicker with a thrown rock than anyone her size has any right to be.

Name: halfling male caveman
Description: A halfling from before halflings had villages, clubbing at the world with whatever came to hand.

Name: buraq
Description: A winged steed with a human face, which crosses in a single stride what a horse crosses in a day.

Name: runicorn
Description: A unicorn whose hide is scored with runes that no hand cut. Magic slides off it and comes back sharpened.

Name: human
Description: A medium-sized creature prone to great ambition. Short-lived but ubiquitous; they are not to be underestimated.

Name: Soul Summoner
Description: He spent a lifetime learning to call the dead, and now they come whether he calls them or not.

Name: ember spitting beetle
Description: A spitting beetle whose glands have gone volcanic, hawking gobbets of burning pitch.

Name: frost beetle
Description: A giant beetle with a carapace of blue-white chitin, breath steaming with cold in the deep dark.

Name: cyan jelly
Description: A jelly the colour of glacier ice, cold to the touch and colder still if it touches back.

Name: green jelly
Description: A jelly that reeks of rot; it dissolves flesh and gear alike to feed itself.

Name: midnight jelly
Description: A jelly black as a starless sky; things it touches for too long forget how alive they were.

Name: red jelly
Description: A jelly that glows faintly like a coal; fire only makes it swell larger and angrier.

Name: violet jelly
Description: A jelly the colour of a bruise, faintly crackling; touching it feels like brushing a doorknob after crossing a carpet in winter.

Name: jungle kobold
Description: A kobold camouflaged in mottled green, more comfortable in the canopy than underground; it spits venom from a hollow reed.

Name: kobold
Description: Unfairly characterised as cowardly and weak, these diminutive reptilian creatures overcome their physical limitations by employing vicious and cunning strategies.

Name: molten gila monster
Description: A gila monster whose beaded hide glows dull orange along the seams, as if lit from beneath.

Name: lizardman
Description: Large, omnivorous reptilians whose bestial ancestors dominated the world long before the birth of civilisation. They are fearsome predators, capable of leaping impressive distances and warding off many attacks with their thick scaly hides.

Name: lizardman samurai
Description: A lizardman who took up a foreign discipline and mastered it. His two blades move faster than his bulk suggests they can.

Name: abyssal shark
Description: A shark bred to lightless ocean trenches, its eyes filmed over and useless.

Name: Merdude
Description: Something enormous came up out of the deep water, and the deep water was glad to be rid of it.

Name: air binder
Description: The second rank, who no longer asks the wind for anything but simply takes it.

Name: air maker
Description: The highest rank of the air school. Where she is standing, the weather is a matter of her preference.

Name: air seeker
Description: The first rank of the air school, who has learned to feel the wind before it moves.

Name: alchemist
Description: Mixes what should not be mixed and takes careful notes, on the occasions when he survives to write them.

Name: archeologist
Description: Digs up other people's tombs for a living, and has learned which ones to leave alone.

Name: assassin
Description: You do not meet an assassin. You meet somebody else, once, and after that you meet nobody at all.

Name: berserker
Description: Fights without armour, without caution, and without any evident expectation of tomorrow.

Name: bishop
Description: He carries a mace because canon law denied him the edge, and he has never once felt the restriction.

Name: bushi
Description: A warrior in the service of a house, thoroughly competent with everything he has ever been handed.

Name: elder wizard
Description: Old enough to have forgotten more magic than most schools teach, and to still remember the dangerous parts.

Name: hag
Description: Old, bent, and owed favours by things that ought not to be in a position to owe favours.

Name: huntress
Description: She tracks for a week and shoots once.

Name: journeyman wizard
Description: Past apprentice, short of master, and painfully aware of the distance between the two.

Name: nun
Description: Devout, unarmed by preference, and armed by necessity rather more often than her order cares to admit.

Name: poison alchemist
Description: He gave up on cures some years ago. The other trade paid better and asked far fewer questions.

Name: savage brute
Description: Enormous, unarmoured, and entirely uninterested in the finer points of anything.

Name: savage stalker
Description: Follows for miles without making a sound, and then picks the moment.

Name: shaolin monk
Description: Thirty years of the same forms, every morning without exception, and now he needs no weapon at all.

Name: temptress
Description: She is friendly, and she is interested in you, and neither of those things is true.

Name: thief
Description: He wants your purse rather than your life, and will take the second only if you insist on it.

Name: trader
Description: Everything has a price, and he will find yours before you have finished speaking.

Name: traveller
Description: Walks the roads between towns carrying everything he owns and a very good stick.

Name: army captain
Description: He has fought campaigns you have only heard rumours of, and he expects the men behind him to keep up.

Name: army lieutenant
Description: A junior officer with a commission bought or earned, leading from the front because that is where he is watched.

Name: army sergeant
Description: The one who taught the soldiers their drill, and who fights rather better than any of them.

Name: army soldier
Description: Rank-and-file infantry, drilled to hold a line with a spear and a shield, and to break it for nobody.

Name: General Breetai
Description: A career officer with a ruined face and a habit of winning. He has never once fought alone.

Name: baby mimic
Description: A young mimic, its shapeshifting still crude — usually just a box that bites back.

Name: grave mimic
Description: It waits among the headstones shaped like one more grave marker, patient as the dead around it.

Name: mimic
Description: A weathered chest, until its lid splits open into a maw ringed with teeth.

Name: mimic coins
Description: A small heap of coins that isn't quite finished counting itself.

Name: minotaur
Description: Monstrous creatures with the head and tail of a bull and the body of a man.

Name: ashen mummy
Description: An orc mummy exhumed from a barrow sealed under a cinder-field; its wrappings are charred and its grip sears whatever it holds.

Name: mellified man
Description: This mummy confection was created by steeping a human cadaver in honey. Somehow reanimated by an obscure cult of monks, it is both deadly and delicious.

Name: bog ogre
Description: An ogre gone half-feral in the fens, its skin sallow and slick; its claws carry a rot no wound-dressing can clean.

Name: orc
Description: Ugly, brutish creatures with cannibalistic tendencies; this warlike race is known for their impressive strength and intellectual incapabilities.

Name: orc thief
Description: An orc who worked out that pockets are a good deal easier to open than skulls.

Name: swamp orc
Description: An orc that has made its home in the marshlands, its blade notched and slicked with venom drawn from swamp adders.

Name: plasmoid
Description: Amorphous beings who have no typical shape but often take on a translucent humanoid form. While unmistakable for anything other than a plasma-like ooze, this form enables the use of clothing and tools.

Name: brown pudding
Description: The lesser of the two ferrozygotic puddings, the brown pudding is said to taste more akin to rotted milk than a chocolate dessert. The pudding itself feeds upon fabrics and hides of all kind but its most known ability is its unique reproductive method. When brought into contact with iron the miracle of rotten slime binary fission takes place, creating two voracious offspring. Owing to the ubiquity of iron in the arms wielded by adventurers, this creature's population has only been growing with time.

Name: tar pudding
Description: A pudding of black, viscid tar that oozes and smoulders at once; anything it swallows comes out cindered.

Name: ashen cave bear
Description: A cave bear whose pelt has gone grey as cinders, hardened by years sheltered in a live volcano's roots.

Name: juggernaut
Description: Beware this clockwork machine of war.

Name: robot
Description: Bipedal mechanical automatons with nearly unbounded artificial intelligence. Powered by a molten core engine that requires a constant supply of raw metals and is susceptible to water damage.

Name: robot female
Description: A humanoid automaton, articulated at every joint, still carrying out whatever it was last told to do.

Name: robot sentry
Description: It was built to stand in one place and stop things, and it is still doing exactly that long after the builders left.

Name: robot singer
Description: It sings the same three phrases in a voice that used to belong to somebody, and it will not be interrupted.

Name: albino rat
Description: A sewer rat gone pure white and pink-eyed, blind from generations in unlit tunnels.

Name: almiraj
Description: A hare with a single straight horn, and no sense whatever of how small it is.

Name: giant hamster
Description: A rodent the size of a dog, cheek pouches bulging with whatever it last found on the floor.

Name: satyr
Description: Fey creatures linked by powerful nature spirits to fuel their antics. They are stocky with furry lower bodies, cloven hooves of a goat and curled horns of a ram. Ribald and clever, they cheerfully lead hedonistic escapades of drinking, dancing and fighting.

Name: frost cobra
Description: A cobra pale as hoarfrost, coiled in the ice caves where warm-blooded prey seeks shelter.

Name: melanistic moccasin
Description: A water moccasin gone jet black, all but invisible against a night-flooded cave pool.

Name: pale cave spider
Description: A cave spider drained of all colour by lightless generations, hunting by web-thrum alone.

Name: tortle
Description: Tortoise-like nomadic survivalists who leave their birthplace, from the moment they can walk, to travel the world with the comfort and protection of home on their backs.

Name: lava troll
Description: A troll that wandered too near a volcano and came out the other side wrong: its hide is cracked magma-rock, glowing at every seam.

Name: troll
Description: Ravenous, predatory species of monstrous humanoid with a severe hunch that causes the backs of their hands to drag on the ground. Despite the awkward physical appearance, they are powerfully built and are infamous for their ability to rapidly recover from any wound to their rubbery hide.

Name: Krull
Description: Small, old, and patient. He has outlived every hunter who assumed that size was the point.

Name: robot male vampire gunslinger
Description: Somebody built a machine, somebody else turned it, and a third party handed it a pistol. All three came to regret their part.

Name: wind sphere
Description: A turning column of wind: enormous, empty, and impossible to hit anywhere that counts.

Name: frost long worm
Description: A long worm that burrows through permafrost, its segmented hide crusted with rime.

Name: bone reaper
Description: A skeleton picked clean by something worse than time; its bones are black at the joints, and its touch draws the warmth out of the living.

Name: plague zombie
Description: A shambling corpse wrapped in weeping buboes; the sickness that killed it did not stop working when it died.

Name: zombietree
Description: A dead tree animated by rot and old malice, its bark split open where a jaw shouldn't be.
